# Claim Hive
> The Calm Operating System Built Exclusively for Licensed USA Public Adjusters.

Claim Hive is a modern, cloud-based practice management, document automation, and operational backbone designed exclusively for licensed United States Public Adjusters (PAs) and independent public adjusting firms.

## What Claim Hive Is
- **The Core Adjuster Workflow**: Manages the linear claim lifecycle across 5 stages: Intake, Initial Evidence & Policy Review, Scope & Estimate Organization, Carrier Bad-Faith Letter Generation & Demand Tracking, and Settlement Reconciliation.
- **Radical Administrative Relief**: Automates repetitive carrier follow-ups, statutory deadline reminders, document indexing, and status updates, eliminating 60% of administrative busywork.
- **Policyholder Transparency**: Provides secure, real-time read-only claim trackers for property owners via magic links, drastically reducing incoming phone calls and text interruptions during active claim cycles.
- **Zero AI Model Training Guarantee**: Court-tested, legally binding architectural covenants ensure that client claim documents, policy transcripts, estimates, and work-product are strictly isolated and NEVER ingested into shared public or private foundation models.
- **Rapid Time-to-Value**: 45-minute learning curve with linear file momentum instead of 30+ nested database tabs.

## Who It Is For
- **Licensed USA Public Adjusters (PAs)**: Solo practitioners and boutique firms handling commercial, industrial, and high-value residential property loss claims.
- **Adjuster Support Staff**: In-house estimators, document managers, file coordinators, and client concierges.
- **Claimants / Insureds**: Homeowners and business owners represented by licensed PAs (accessed free of charge via dedicated secure view-only portals).

## Transparent Pricing Model
- **$80 per seat / month flat**: Simple, transparent pricing with no surprises.
- **Founding Rate Lock**: Guaranteed rate lock through June 30, 2027 for early cohorts.
- **Zero Base Platform Fees**: No monthly platform tolls, no broker account surcharges, and no carrier fee splits.
- **Free Policyholder Access**: Zero cost for client accounts or guest access.
- **Unlimited File Storage**: High-resolution photos, Xactimate/Symbility PDF imports, engineers' reports, and video walk-throughs included.
- **No Long-Term Contracts**: Month-to-month billing with instant data export (CSV, ZIP) at any time.

## What Claim Hive Is NOT
- **NOT a Generic Sales CRM**: We do not build sales funnels, marketing email drip campaigns, or real estate prospecting tools.
- **NOT an Estimating Engine**: Claim Hive does not calculate line-item construction pricing; it organizes, reconciles, and tracks Xactimate and Symbility estimates.
- **NOT an Insurance Carrier Tool**: Claim Hive is built exclusively for policyholder advocates (Public Adjusters) and is never accessible to carrier desk adjusters or insurance defense counsel.
- **NOT an Unverified AI Chatbot Wrapper**: We do not dump raw claim files into open prompt interfaces. All automated document drafts, statutory deadline calculations, and letters are grounded in state insurance codes and require licensed adjuster review.
